header.description: Netsuite Vendor Return Authorization import flow, listens for request from MES-NS-NetSuite Inbound Flow with record data posted from Netsuite, using record id additional details are queried from Netsuite and created in Fuuz DB

nodes.name: JavaScript: FORMAT VEND AUTH RETURN/LINES QUERY

data.transform:
return `
SELECT 
  t.*,
  l.*,
  i.itemtype
FROM 
  transaction t
LEFT JOIN transactionline l 
  ON t.id=l.transaction 
LEFT JOIN item i
  ON i.id=l.item
WHERE
  t.id = ${$state.context.REQUEST.DATA.id}
  AND
--  l.taxline='F'
--    AND
  t.type = 'VendAuth'

`
